study: MR-CGE V1.3 Two-Hop Cross Controlled Screening
failure_summary: The initial six GPU campaigns could not obtain a reliable NVIDIA driver snapshot in the sandbox. Campaigns 7 and 8 passed 1/6 and 4/6 cells before fresh ownership/resource checks stopped them. After the user authorized shared GPU 1 execution, campaign 9 passed all six cells with CUDA runtime memory checks; earlier blocked records remain preserved in gpu_preflight.json and failures.json.
next_action: No Stage 2 runs are authorized because neither Stage 1 arm passed the registered promotion gates. Any follow-up needs a separately registered experiment.
